copy.curiosityHook: Awakening into a ruined future where your friends are now foes, whom can you trust when the next clash could end everything?
copy.description: Fourteen years after Third Impact, Shinji Ikari awakens unaged in a devastated world where NERV is dismantled, his former allies have turned hostile, and he must navigate a new battle alongside the enigmatic Kaworu.
copy.vibeSummary: Immersive and heavy sci-fi action filled with dread, suspenseful escalations, and brisk, concentrated apocalyptic conflict.
copy.whyWatch: A fast-moving, emotionally heavy sci-fi drama that plunges into apocalyptic dread, pitting former comrades against each other in intense, high-stakes animated warfare.

allowedMaterial: Shinji awakens fourteen years later unaged to a ruined Earth
NERV dismantled and former allies turned against him
Ongoing battles against angels and former allies escalating toward apocalyptic stakes
excludedMaterial: Specific third-act resolutions or catastrophic outcomes
Hidden origins or true identities of Kaworu and others
Later casualties, deaths, or definitive relationship endings
Final fate of the world and ultimate battle results
